label: BMS Alerts
info:
Deterministic BMS alerting, separate from the daily Gemini report.

Polls the collector on the Cerbo every 15 minutes and emails when a
condition that needs action appears. Evaluation is explicit rather than
AI-judged, so it cannot miss a threshold or invent one.

CRITICAL conditions re-notify every 12 hours while unresolved.
WARNING conditions notify once per 24 hours.
A resolved condition sends one all-clear.

Dedupe state lives in flow context, so a Node-RED restart may repeat one
notification for an active condition. That is deliberate: better a
duplicate than a missed alert.

The collector being unreachable is itself a critical alert - the failure
mode this is most meant to catch is the monitoring silently dying.

name: Poll the BMS collector every 15 min and email anything that needs action
info:
Thresholds live in the 'Evaluate Conditions' function node.
Baselines were measured on this bank: 2.07 A current deadband,
14-21 mV resting cell spread, 0.2-0.4 mOhm internal resistance.
